name: samong
description: Search and write your own Markdown notes. Local-first: nothing leaves the machine.
long_description:
Samong indexes a folder of Markdown notes and exposes it to an agent over MCP: full-text search that handles languages written without spaces between words, a [[wikilink]] graph, and read/write access to the notes themselves. Notes are plain files in a folder you already have. Nothing is uploaded anywhere, and no account is involved.

Notes installed from someone else's vault are read-only and come back from search labelled with who published them and under what licence, so quoted material stays attributable.

tools.name: list_vaults
tools.description: List every registered vault on this machine

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List every note in a vault by path

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read one note by its vault-relative path

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Create or overwrite a note (refuses read-only reference notes)

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Full-text search across one vault or all of them

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Forward links and backlinks for a note
